verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served at pulumi.com/llms.txt, and a second llms.txt exists at pulumi.com/dev/llms.txt. Pulumi also documents Agent Skills, knowledge packages that teach AI coding assistants Pulumi workflows, which gives agents a further agent-oriented docs surface. missing for 10: markdown versions of docs pages (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these files effectively.
